rubric.role_summary: Senior customer success role for a contract automation platform, managing a ~$3M customer portfolio, supporting retention and expansion, and developing scalable customer success playbooks and automation.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior customer success role for a contract automation platform, managing a ~$3M customer portfolio, supporting retention and expansion, and developing scalable customer success playbooks and automation.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Customer-facing experience at an AI or SaaS scale-up (Series A–D); 3+ years is an orientation, not a strict minimum.
- Experience identifying and nurturing customer relationships across multiple accounts.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Approximately 3+ years of the specified customer-facing experience, treated as an orientation rather than a cutoff.
- Preference for working from the Boston office at least approximately two days a week.
- Experience engaging senior stakeholders, including Director level and above, in value-led conversations.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Massachusetts, US. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition. Explicit work-attendance terms (city labels use the area interpretation above): For this role, we prioritise candidates who prefer to work from our Boston office at least ~2 days a week.

soft_requirements: Strong discovery and problem-solving skills; proactively investigates customer problems and takes action.
